Records.authors: Thomas Gehrmann, Andreas von Manteuffel, Lorenzo Tancredi, Erich Weihs
Records.description: The authors compute the full set of massless two-loop four-point functions with two off-shell legs with the same invariant mass relevant for diboson production at hadron colliders ($q\bar{q} \to VV$ and $gg \to VV$). The $\varepsilon$ expansion is given in terms of multiple polylogarithms of uniform weight through to weight four. Results for physical scattering kinematics are optimized for numerical evaluations using $\operatorname{Li}_{2,2}$, $\operatorname{Li}_n$ and $\log$ functions. In addition, expansions are provided at the production threshold and in the small mass limit.

Records.authors: Johannes M. Henn, Kirill Melnikov, Vladimir A. Smirnov
Records.description: The authors compute all two-loop planar master integrals needed for the computation of the production of off-shell vector bosons in hadron collisions. The arXiv contains files with all these integrals, while the definitions and prefactors are given in the paper in Sect. 7. The $\varepsilon$ expansion is given in terms of multiple polylogarithms of uniform weight through to weight four.

Records.authors: Mikhail V. Kompaniets and Erik Panzer
Records.description: massless propagator computed for the $\varphi^4$ 6-loop calculation available from the ancillary files p_int_g4.mpl (Maple) and p_int_g4.m (Mathematica) of the arXiv submission results are rational linear combinations of multiple zeta values. The pInt[2,1] period for this 2-loop 4-propagator topology is imported here as a Result: value = Cfull^2 * (anc g4 period), cross-checked against the existing independent library computation of the same integral.
Records.verifiedVia: cross-checked low-loop import (validation policy 2026-06-22). value_ST = Cfull^2 * anc[pInt[2,1]], with Cfull = Exp[eps*EulerGamma] Gamma[1+eps] Gamma[1-eps]^2/Gamma[2-2eps] converting the ancillary G-scheme normalization to the SubTropica normalization per loop (Cfull verified independently at L=4 and L=5 by pySD-Euclidean). The ancillary period is from Kompaniets-Panzer (arXiv:1705.06483; peer-reviewed HyperInt; trusted). VERIFIED by cross-check against the existing INDEPENDENT library computation of the same integral: the entry's existing independent library Result for the same single-scale massless propagator integral (leading orders confirmed to agree at unit scale). The CNI->anc bridge is confirmed by an explicit vertex isomorphism {1->2, 2->1, 3->3} (anc->lib; brute-force). NOT validated against HyperFLINT/STIntegrate (a HyperInt reimplementation -> circular).

Records.authors: T. Gehrmann, E.W.N. Glover, T. Huber, N. Ikizlerli, C. Studerus
Records.description: The authors give all master integrals used in the computation of quark and gluon form factors to three loops in QCD. These integrals are available in Appendix A and all have a prefactor given by Eq. A.1.

The integrals in this paper are given as analytic functions in $d$ dimensions, so that all orders in $\varepsilon$ are covered. The common prefactor to all integrals is $(4\pi)^{(4-d)/2} \Gamma(3-d/2) \Gamma^2(d/2-1)/\Gamma(d-3)$. Be aware that all these integrals have at least one off-shell leg.

import.method: Single-scale phi^4 propagator integral, external scale restored. value = (p^2)^{0 - 2 eps} * Cfull^2 * anc[pInt[2,1]]: the KP G-scheme period series (Cfull = Exp[eps*EulerGamma] Gamma[1+eps] Gamma[1-eps]^2/Gamma[2-2eps], G-scheme -> SubTropica normalization per loop) with the external Euclidean invariant restored, so the stored value is the dimensionful momentum-space integral, not the p^2=1 reduced form. g4: IRR-rearranged auxiliary p-integral (NOT a phi^4 self-energy); 2L-V=0; I ~ (p2)^{-2 eps}; log-divergent, dimensionless. p2 = -MM > 0 : the spacelike (mostly-plus) external invariant, = minus the package mostly-minus Euclidean MM (MM<0; conventions.md L918-924). value = (p2)^{0 - 2 eps} * (dimensionless p2=1 form) is REAL for p2>0 (KP G-scheme). At the pySD anchor MM=-1, i.e. p2=+1, the scale factor is 1, reproducing the anchored period; the i*pi tower appears only on continuation to timelike p2<0 (MM>0). NOT computed by STIntegrate/HyperFLINT (a HyperInt reimplementation; using it to validate the ancillary HyperInt value would be circular).
